rows.text: The Synesthesia Dreamscape doesn't just exist in the Asdana system. The Somoh of the Southern Orion system have long adapted to high concentrations of memoria, in the way that inhabitants of ocean planets are familiar with water. Their sixth tentacle possesses a special gland, allowing them to enter dreams without the aid of devices. The Somoh use the fuzz on their tentacles to weave nets, dredging items from the river of the collective unconscious, capturing sweet dreams and blocking nightmares. Today, this handicraft has completely integrated into Somoh culture, giving form to an indispensable household safety item. When The Family attempted to assimilate the Southern Orion system using the Synesthesia Dreamscape, every Somoh household donated their dreamcatcher, building a wall at the edge of reality. Just like it had for thousands of years past, the dreamcatcher successfully kept the nightmares at bay.
